headline: TWO FINDINGS. (1) ESCALATION #17 IS STALE — the exit-ladder candle OOS was CLOSED 2026-10-17 by two verdicts (brain/verdicts/2026-10-17_exit-ladder-tat-grid.md: 'P0 CLOSED, do not re-request a universal or progressive cut'; 2026-10-17_trail-arm-candle-oos.md) and has been re-printed as an open escalation 61 times since. The REAL remaining reached-arm leak is now quantified and re-scoped: atr_sl_hit reached-arm 14d = 33T 3.0% '-1.99', avg MFE 0.797% / MAX MFE 1.177% / 0 of 33 ever reached +1.50% vs profit-monster-trail avg MFE 0.756% and atr_trail_hit avg MFE 3.031% -> these are ARM-THEN-IMMEDIATE-REVERSAL trades that armed at +0.40 and fell back through the untouched ATR SL (avg MAE 0.341) before the ratchet's first rung could move it. Next measurement (pre-registered): what fraction of reached-arm trades ever see the stop tightened past entry, i.e. is the BE/ratchet path firing at all between arm and atr_sl_hit. (2) BUG SHIPPED: momentum_cache.trend was a dual-writer collision — 15m_regime_scanner.py:297 wrote it with threshold 0.05 on 15m slope 96x/day while 4h_regime_scanner.py:289 wrote it with threshold 0.10 on 4h slope 6x/day into the SAME momentum_cache(token) row; last writer won and the 15m scanner won ~94% of the time, so trades.entry_trend was a coin-flip between two timeframes. Fixed: trend is now 4h-scanner-owned, 15m no longer writes it. Zero trading behavior (no gate reads momentum_cache.trend; sniper_exit.py:161's trend branch is dead code comparing against 'rising'/'falling' which neither writer emits — it still works via regime_4h).

config_changes_applied.rationale: Dual-writer collision: 15m scanner wrote trend from 15m slope with REGIME_SCANNER_TREND_THRESHOLD=0.05 every 15min; 4h scanner wrote trend from 4h slope with threshold 0.10 every 4h. Same column, same row, different thresholds, different timeframes — last writer wins and 15m runs 16x more often, so the 4h trend was destroyed continuously. feature_recorder.get_token_intel reads that column and stores it as trades.entry_trend, so entry_trend was a coin-flip. 4h scanner now also carries an ownership comment.
config_changes_applied.impact: Zero trading behavior. Analysis correctness restored; entry_trend becomes unambiguously 4h going forward.
